Subject: Vendr annual evidence refresh — action required

Hi Ben,

We’re doing our annual vendor evidence refresh for Redwood’s Vendr profile. Could you please upload the following artifacts to the Vendr security portal (link below) by next Thursday, Oct 7?

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine)
- Completed CAIQ spreadsheet
- High-level network diagram (public-facing components & egress)
- Primary security contact (name + email + role)

Portal link: https://app.vendr.com/company/redwood-inference/profile
If you prefer, you can also share the files via Whistic and we’ll pull them into the profile.

We’ll mark this as part of our review for Q4, and we may follow up with a short set of control questions.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Liam O’Connor
Vendor Risk Manager, Vendr

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up. I’ve looped in Neha (Security) and Marissa (Security Ops) to coordinate the uploads. A couple quick clarifying questions before we send anything over:

1) Can we upload a redacted SOC 2 Type II with vendor contact info removed?
2) Is there a preferred filename convention for the CAIQ you want in the portal?

If it helps, we’ll collect everything on our side and either upload to the Vendr portal or share a Whistic link. Targeting end of day Wed (Oct 6) to give you a buffer.

If you have a short checklist beyond the items above, please drop it here.

Thanks for the ping, Ben. I’ll own the evidence pack; here’s what we should provide and how: 

Required artifacts (preferred formats):
- SOC 2 Type II report: PDF, redacted for customer data (remove external customer names). Filename: SOC_2_Type_II_2025_redacted.pdf
- CAIQ: spreadsheet (XLSX), completed answers saved as CAIQ_Responses_2026.xlsx
- Network diagram: PNG (accepted) or PDF; include DMZ, load balancers, and egress destinations. Filename: network_diagram_vpc.png
- Contact: Primary security contact: Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwood.ai), Secondary: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai)

Portal instructions: upload directly to the Vendr profile (they pull metadata automatically). If the portal rejects large PDFs, drop to Whistic and send the link.

Operational notes:
- Please also include a short control narrative (bullet list) describing incident response cadence, encryption at rest/in transit, and patching cadence (1–2 paragraphs).
- I’ve opened a Jira ticket (SEC-4122) to track this refresh and retention of the artifacts. Mark the retention period as 12 months in the portal.

Ben — can you attach the documents to your reply when you send to Liam (or confirm upload link)? I’ll review once uploaded.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
